requested_outcome: The mobile global header always shows the complete current world label on one readable line, including routes that also show the header search action.
natural_destination: VII mobile header on world landing and place-detail routes
authorization_boundary: Local code, tests and local rendered verification are authorized. Public deployment is not authorized by this request.

lesson_bundle.reason: The reported defect is a mobile readability and breakpoint-transition failure.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires rendered first-viewport checks at 390, 360 and 340 pixel widths, including overflow measurements.

lesson_bundle.reason: The shared header affects every public route and needs affected-family regression evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires testing both header variants, chooser interaction and preservation of all utility controls.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The events label is still split, clipped or abbreviated at a narrow breakpoint.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reserve a measured non-shrinking selector width and prohibit word wrapping in the compact label.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Rendered label has one line and its bounding box remains inside the trigger at 390, 360 and 340 pixels.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The fix works on events but fails on a detail page that also shows the search icon.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Define an explicit narrow-header priority rule for the header-search variant.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: On a place-detail route, search, world selector and menu remain visible without horizontal overflow.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Making the label fit crops the logo, removes the chooser chevron or reduces touch targets.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve logo sizing, the chevron and 44-pixel utility controls in the shared header contract.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Logo, chevron and all visible actions remain contained and interactive at every tested width.

sources.label: VII accepted mobile staged-flow and shared-product standard

midpoint_gate.trigger: After CSS and static contract tests pass, before rendered browser verification.
checks: All narrow breakpoints reserve sufficient selector width.
The route variant with header search has a documented space-priority rule.

attack_questions: Can the label escape or wrap at 340, 360 or 390 pixels?
Does adding the header search icon force any action or logo outside the viewport?
Does the selector still open and retain its chevron and touch height?
Does the header overflow during a width transition?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Local rendered screenshots and DOM geometry from the actual events and business routes.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Static regression tests for both header variants plus rendered checks across three narrow widths.

effectiveness.baseline: At narrow mobile width the compact events label wraps and is visibly clipped because the trigger is forced down to 56 or 44 pixels and overflow-wrap is anywhere.
effectiveness.target: Zero label wraps, zero header horizontal overflow and zero missing required controls across both header variants.
